ground.aware_time: preserve instant; convert, never apply offset twice
ground.unit_evidence: paper 10.1029/2020EA001599; not a unit column in author CSV
ground.quality_flag: ABSENT_IN_AUTHOR_TABLE; preserve raw value and missing state, never invent instrument QA

satellite.scale_offset: apply declared attributes; range and fill evaluated in stored representation
satellite.time_priority: explicit observation time metadata before custom filename; never Algorithm release or template System time
satellite.hour_aggregation: mean of actual QA-passing scan neighborhood means inside left-closed right-open hour
satellite.composites: accept actual interval wholly within one target hour; reject cross-hour composites rather than invent within-interval evolution
satellite.missing: preserve mask; no cross-hour borrowing or fabricated scans

space.all_distance_methods: same projected easting/northing in metres, including IDW
space.domain: training convex hull; no unsupported extrapolation
space.projected_input: must declare a projected CRS; never interpret metre coordinates as degrees

evaluation.test_unseal: only after validation selection artifact is frozen
